Ava (AE): Cerulean Systems wants an auth POC focused on SSO/SCIM and RBAC. Legal flagged EU-only residency, BYOK, multi-domain verification, and a firm Dedicated quote if we need reserved capacity. Can SE/PS/sec triage?
Diego (Solutions Eng): On it. Quick clarifiers: primary IdP? Okta/Azure? SP-initiated preferred? SCIM: full lifecycle + groups + custom attrs?
Ava (AE): Primary IdP is Okta, plus an Azure AD org. They prefer SP-initiated. SCIM = users + groups + two custom attrs (employeeType, deptCode). Domain list: cerulean.com, eu.cerulean.com, partners.cerulean.net.
Diego (Solutions Eng): Tech notes to share:
- SAML: support HTTP-POST & Redirect bindings; signed assertions supported; optional encrypted assertions (AES-256). Need their IdP metadata XML.
- SCIM: v2.0 with PATCH (RFC7644) and incremental delta token support. Example PATCH to add group member:
PATCH /scim/v2/Groups/456
Content-Type: application/json
[ { "op": "add", "path": "members", "value": [{"value":"user-101"}] } ]
- Domain enforcement: tenant-level `verified_domains` and `signup_policy: verified_only`.
- Rate limits: hosted default 60 reqs/min; Dedicated configurable.
Pri (Pricing): For sizing I need estimated monthly tokens and peak concurrent requests. Ballpark: small Dedicated (2x) ~$11k/mo, mid (4x) ~$21k/mo, large (8x) ~$39k/mo. BYOK + EU-region + extended audit are add-ons. Will produce 3 scenarios once we have numbers.
Nora (Security): From questionnaire: BYOK requirement, KMS integration steps, SOC2 attestation, pen-test summary, and log export to their SIEM. We have SOC2 Type II and support customer-managed keys (AWS/GCP/Azure). Audit logs retained 90 days by default; can extend. If they need strict EU-only controls recommend Dedicated in EU region or Private deployment (6-9 week timeline).
Ava (AE): Legal wants short canned responses for questions 4.1-4.6 by EOD Fri. Can we assemble short bullets + attachments (SOC2 PDF, BYOK guide, pen-test summary)?
Diego (Solutions Eng): I'll draft the tech appendix (SAML metadata example, SCIM attribute mapping, group->role mapping example) and drop in shared drive. Need Okta metadata + a sample CSV for initial provisioning.
Pri (Pricing): I'll draft pricing scenarios and include add-on costs for BYOK and EU residency, plus term discounts.
Nora (Security): I'll upload a compliance pack and a short mitigation note. Also confirm whether they want SCIM audit logs redacted; we can enable attribute redaction for logs on request.
provision-bot: POC workspace created: https://console.redwood.example/tenancy/poc-cerulean (id: poc-ceru-202408). Invite sent to poc@cerulean.com :white_check_mark:
Ava (AE): Timeline: kickoff next Wednesday, 10-business-day POC, decision in 30 days. Owners: Diego = SE, Pri = pricing, Nora = security. I'll request Okta metadata + sample CSV from their admin.
Diego (Solutions Eng): Quick config snippet to share for group->role mapping: `{"groupName":"platform-engineers","mappedRole":"platform:engineer"}`.
Pri (Pricing): Will include committed monthly examples and a cost table for Dedicated vs Private.
Nora (Security): Uploaded compliance pack to shared drive and added a BYOK integration doc link.
Ava (AE): Thanks team 64f. We'll consolidate and send to Cerulean legal by Fri EOD.
(threads end)
